colourAuthority: Sampled palette anchors govern over plan constants (AUTO-L04, ledgered). Anchor tokens below carry the sampled value; the plan constant is kept as provenance, with its ΔE00, never as the value. Per Visual Plan REC-1, this token source is the one shipped source of colour: Bible palette = targets (measurement only), scene palette.js and Blender assets/palette.json are generated serialisations of these tokens. Exception, by the Bible's own delta path (visual-plan/03-refinement.md §1.5): a Owner ruling may amend an anchor — the amendment lives in extract-palette.mjs (RULED_AMENDMENTS) and palette-anchors.json, the sampled hex is kept there as evidence, and the token follows the amended anchor with the ruling cited in its provenance. One anchor carries such an amendment today: grass_sunlit (2026-11-03, D-T02 settled).

material.family.about: M4.07 building material families for the 3D scene: six treatments (civic / College / Market / work / social / home). Every role colour is COPIED from the named anchor or family token in roleSources — anchors arbitrate (AUTO-L04) and no family colour exists outside this artefact. Place-family colour codes the treatment, per plan/01 §5.2; building albedo comes from the sampled anchors, not the unpinned place-family plan names. Consumed by the scene through the generated palette (build/visual/scene/palette.mjs).

provenance.note: Civic: Town Hall. Blush-cream spire roof is the sampled anchor (the plan constant was pinker — Bible §3, retuned to the anchor). Accent is the pinned civic gold.

College family: the College and its Library Annex share the treatment (the annex is the College's, by name and function — recorded assignment, M4.07). The unpinned "deep teal" place-family name is NOT used as albedo (tokens note on color.family.place.college); the lavender roof anchor governs.
Market: timber walls under the awning-cream roof (the sampled awning/banner cream carries the market's canopy register). The unpinned "terracotta" place name is not an albedo source.

Work / making: the Workshop and the Ember Ledger press. plan/01 §5.2 equates the making place family with the work act family; a printing press is a workplace, so District 1 Plot 31 takes this treatment (recorded assignment, M4.07).

Social / gathering: Meridian Hall (the record's dinners and gatherings) and the Plaza of Unity. Wall is the sign-wood anchor (the hall register the sample shows); accent is the pinned social lilac. The Plaza has no walls: its ground/groundShade roles carry the cobble anchors.

Home: the cottages. color.family.place.homes is "varied pastel" by design; v1 of this treatment gives both cottages the blossom roof and varies nothing else (recorded simplification, M4.07). Unlisted place codes fall back to this family in the scene (palette defaultFamily) — a scaffold default, recorded here, never silent.
